record_kind: Maintained partial layout specification and source provenance; external helpers/reports are separate.

source_rules.coordinate_units: Focus grid, not pixels. Base=resolved anchor base+scriptxy. Final=resolved anchor final+scriptxy+own active offsets.
source_rules.progression: Prerequisite groups are AND between blocks and OR among focus entries within one block. Relative anchor does not imply progression.
source_rules.offset_model: Preserve seven direct offset blocks and evaluate their actual completion/rule triggers once along each anchor chain.
source_rules.visibility_model: For modeled source visibility only, require own and relative-anchor ancestor allow_branch expressions; availability/actual engine hide lifecycle are not simulated.

context_selection: Affected seven, their anchor chains/progression parents/children and siblings sharing those progression parents, plus all nodes within dx8/dy3 of each affected base position.

geometry_model.grid_role: Existing port documented geometric model, not a new engine-spacing measurement.
geometry_model.limitations: Source item/title/textbox rectangles do not bound symbol/glow/shine/glyph extents. Real connections, exclusions, scroll limits and hit areas require UI observation.
